clips.title: The story
paras: Reclaiming the Charred Vale is a messenger quest tasked by Keeper Albagorm in Stonetalon Peak. Having temporarily suppressed the local harpies, Albagorm sends an Alliance traveler far south to Feralas to recruit the aid of the druid Falfindel Waywarder.

The Charred Vale in southern Stonetalon Mountains remains an ash-choked reminder of catastrophic devastation. While Alliance forces under Keeper Albagorm have struck back against the rampant Bloodfury harpies nesting in the ruins, driving them off is merely a holding action. Albagorm recognizes that physical force alone cannot mend the ravaged earth before the harpies rally and reclaim their dominance.

To permanently restore the scorched lands, the grove tenders need mystical intervention beyond their current means. Albagorm dispatches a courier far to the south, skirting past the salt flats and canyons of Thousand Needles to Thalanaar on the border of Feralas. There waits Falfindel Waywarder, a night elf druid reputed to possess the rare power to call forth primordial forest spirits capable of rejuvenating the dead soil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Bloodfuries have been subdued. But they will regroup soon enough if action is not taken.

Far south of the Barrens lies a land known as Thousand Needles. If you travel west in Thousand Needles until you reach the lush forest's edge of Feralas, you will find a druid named Falfindel Waywarder.
This great and wise druid is capable of calling forth great forest spirits which can aid in the reclamation of the Charred Vale.
Send word of our need! Seek him out at once!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Keeper Albagorm was wise to send you with such urgency.
Let us see if we cannot call forth aid from the great forest to travel to the Charred Vale before it is too late.
